govdocs-archive_org-nsia-MannAbby_Mann_A: This G-man note to boss Sullivan — November 27, 1963 — is a Bureau file. The opened note is a first-hand source. Sullivan ran the home-front spy shop. The note may hold a clue. Bookmen prize such files. The file fits the government shelf.
catholic-encyclopedia-1913-abbey-of-whit: A 1913 Catholic Encyclopedia entry on Whitby, the Yorkshire abbey of St. Hilda. Kings and saints walked its cliff-top cloister. Gilbert Huddleston tells of its founding and fame. The Synod of Whitby in 664 settled England's Easter date. Caedmon, the cowherd poet, sang within its walls.
catholic-encyclopedia-1913-anthony-brook: This 1913 reference article on Anthony Brookby — the Franciscan martyr of Henry VIII. Stephen Donovan honors his death. He died for the papal primacy. The entry preserves his modest fame. A friar of the English martyrs. His death honored the London Charterhouse.
